---

Two census years were searched across the state of Virginia for families carrying the Dixon surname. In 1840, six Dixon-headed households were found spread across six different counties: Ohio, Rockingham, Augusta, Fairfax, Henrico, and Frederick. Because the 1840 census only recorded the name of the head of household, other family members appear only as tick marks by age and sex — no other Dixons are named within those households. In 1850 the search returned over 2,200 results, which is far too many to tabulate reliably at the statewide level; only one household (Edmund Dixon in Ohio County, with Mary Dixon listed alongside him) was captured before the search was halted. The table in the log holds all 1840 households in full, plus that single partial 1850 glimpse.

To complete the 1850 portion, please say which county or counties in Virginia you want to focus on and the survey will re-run at that narrower scope.
